full_prompt_en: A square expressionist painting shows a seated artist working over loose papers at a table covered in vivid pink cloth. The artist sits left of center on a simple wooden chair, leaning forward with one hand drawing or painting on a pale sheet. A small yellow cap sits above a face mostly submerged in deep blue-black shadow; a brightly patterned short-sleeved shirt, dark trousers and strong brown arms remain visible. The table spreads across the lower right, crowded with papers, a brush, jars, a glass of amber liquid, small containers and irregular patches of pigment. Behind it, another low table holds propped images and materials. A saturated teal wall fills the left background, interrupted by a few rough rectangular images, while dark green and purple marks thicken the right rear corner. The floor is nearly as colorful as the table, with pink and turquoise areas crossed by dark lines. Brushwork is broad and broken, leaving edges only partly resolved; facial detail matters less than the rhythm of the bent body, tabletop and scattered studio objects. Yellow, orange and white marks flash against blue-black shadows, giving the scene energetic tonal contrast. Light comes from the upper right and spreads unevenly over the working surface, catching the papers and forearms while leaving the face dark. Paint layers remain visibly textured and somewhat scraped. No readable text can be distinguished. The overall composition feels immediate and busy, holding a focused working gesture within a turbulent field of pink, teal, yellow and shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现主义绘画呈现一名坐着的艺术家伏在散纸上工作，桌面铺着鲜艳粉色桌布。艺术家坐在中央偏左的简朴木椅上，身体前倾，一只手在浅色纸上绘画。小黄帽下的面部大多沉在深蓝黑阴影中；花纹鲜亮的短袖衬衫、深裤和结实的棕色手臂仍清楚可见。桌子向右下展开，堆着纸、笔刷、瓶罐、一杯琥珀色液体、小容器和不规则颜料斑块。其后另一张矮桌摆着支起的图片与材料。饱和青蓝墙面填满左侧背景，几张粗糙矩形图片打断其间；深绿与紫色笔痕在右后角变密。地面几乎同桌面一样多彩，粉与绿松石区域被深线穿过。笔触宽阔而破碎，边缘只部分解决；脸部细节不如俯身身体、桌面与散落工作物件的节奏重要。黄、橙与白色笔痕在蓝黑阴影前闪亮，形成有活力的明暗对比。光从右上方而来，不均匀地铺在工作面上，照到纸和前臂，却让面部保持暗色。颜料层明显有纹理，也略有刮擦。无法辨认可读文字。整体构图即时而忙碌，把专注工作姿态放在粉、青蓝、黄与阴影组成的动荡色场里。
style_prompt_en: An expressive painted treatment uses thick, visibly broken strokes and abrupt overlaps of hot pink, turquoise, yellow, orange and deep blue-black. Broad saturated planes set the structure, while smaller scraped and dabbed marks scatter energy across them. Contours appear only where value or color needs separation; elsewhere forms merge into neighboring patches. Strong warm accents jump forward from cool dark areas, creating depth through color conflict rather than smooth perspective. Uneven side light catches selected pale surfaces but leaves others in heavy shadow. Dense detail gathers around the lower and central zones, while larger background color fields keep the image from becoming visually flat. The overall effect is lively, tactile and deliberately unresolved.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性绘画处理使用厚实、明显破碎的笔触，以及亮粉、绿松石、黄、橙和深蓝黑的突然重叠。宽阔饱和色面建立结构，更小的刮擦与点涂痕迹在其上散布能量。只有明度或色彩需要分界处才出现轮廓；其他地方形体融入邻近色块。强暖色重音从冷暗区域前跳出，纵深来自色彩冲突，而非平滑透视。不均匀侧光照亮少数浅色表面，其他部分仍留重影。密集细节聚在下部与中央，更大的背景色域则避免画面视觉上过于平板。整体活泼、有触感，也刻意保留未完全收束的状态。
theme_en: An artist working over a paper-covered table in a vivid pink and teal studio
theme_zh: 一名艺术家在艳粉与青蓝色工作室里伏案创作
name: Robert Colescott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
